meta.description: AI Energy Agent decision log with rationale and counterfactuals
meta.disclaimer: SIMULATED TELEMETRY — demonstration dataset. Not actual customer data.

decisions.title: Charge BESS from solar surplus
decisions.why: Forecast shows 1.4 MW of PV surplus for 42 minutes from 12:20. Charging now displaces evening peak import at ₹10.40/kWh.
decisions.whatHappens: BESS charges at 1.4 MW, reaching 78% SoC by 13:05.
decisions.counterfactual: Surplus is exported at a net-billing rate of ₹3.10/kWh — ₹18,400 of value is forgone.

decisions.title: Discharge BESS into evening peak
decisions.why: Maximum demand is forecast to reach 9.8 MW against a 10.2 MVA ceiling during the 18:00 peak block.
decisions.whatHappens: BESS discharges 1.8 MW for 95 minutes, holding MD at 8.1 MW.
decisions.counterfactual: MD excursion probability rises to 68%; a single excursion resets the billing peak for 12 months.

decisions.title: Re-sequence chiller plant
decisions.why: Chiller 2 is at 41% part load where measured CoP falls to 3.4 against 5.1 for single-chiller operation.
decisions.whatHappens: Chiller 2 stops; chiller 1 ramps to 74%. Chilled-water supply holds at 7 °C.
decisions.counterfactual: Part-load penalty continues, costing about ₹1,320 per hour until the load rises.

decisions.title: Defer EV charging past peak
decisions.why: Nine of fourteen sessions have departure slack beyond 22:00. Deferral avoids the peak tariff block entirely.
decisions.whatHappens: 0.6 MW of charging moves to the 22:15 off-peak window. All vehicles meet departure SoC.
decisions.counterfactual: Charging completes in the peak block at ₹10.40/kWh instead of ₹5.40/kWh.

decisions.title: Shift grinding line by 90 minutes
decisions.why: Order-book slack allows the grinding line to start at 19:30 instead of 18:00, avoiding the evening peak.
decisions.whatHappens: Line 3 start moves to 19:30. Shift pattern and labour cost unchanged.
decisions.counterfactual: The line draws 2.1 MW through the most expensive tariff block of the day.

decisions.title: Pre-cool thermal storage
decisions.why: Ambient conditions give a chiller CoP of 5.2 before 08:00, against 3.9 in the afternoon.
decisions.whatHappens: Thermal storage charges 3.1 MWh overnight, displacing afternoon chiller load.
decisions.counterfactual: Afternoon cooling is met at a CoP of 3.9, costing about ₹22,900 more per day.

decisions.title: Reduce non-critical HVAC for flexibility event
decisions.why: A 2-hour flexibility window clears at ₹4.10/kWh. Office and non-process HVAC can give 0.8 MW.
decisions.whatHappens: Setpoints rise 1.5 °C in non-process zones for 120 minutes, then recover.
decisions.counterfactual: The flexibility revenue opportunity lapses unclaimed.

decisions.title: Start DG set for peak avoidance
decisions.why: Marginal DG cost is ₹14.20/kWh against a peak grid rate of ₹10.40/kWh.
decisions.whatHappens: The agent recommends against DG start. Grid import remains the cheaper option.
decisions.counterfactual: No action needed — declining to act is the correct outcome here.

decisions.title: Nominate open-access schedule
decisions.why: Day-ahead open-access nomination closes in 3 hours. Forecast load supports a 6 MW block.
decisions.whatHappens: Recommendation only. A licensed intermediary executes any regulated transaction.
decisions.counterfactual: The nomination window closes and the block reverts to higher-cost grid supply.

decisions.title: Correct power factor
decisions.why: PF has drifted to 0.943, below the 0.95 incentive threshold, exposing the site to a penalty.
decisions.whatHappens: APFC stage 3 switches in, restoring PF to 0.978.
decisions.counterfactual: The PF penalty accrues at roughly ₹3,500 per day.

decisions.title: Hold BESS rack 4 out of dispatch
decisions.why: Cell-group voltage divergence on rack 4 exceeds the 28 mV plausibility band.
decisions.whatHappens: Rack 4 is isolated from the dispatch stack. Available power drops to 4.2 MW.
decisions.counterfactual: Continued cycling of a diverging rack risks accelerated degradation and a warranty dispute.

decisions.title: Apply AHU night setback
decisions.why: Six AHUs held daytime setpoints through the night block, costing 0.4 MW of avoidable load.
decisions.whatHappens: Night setback schedule is applied from 22:00 to 06:00.
decisions.counterfactual: About 3.2 MWh per night is consumed with no occupancy benefit.

decisions.title: Reduce contract demand
decisions.why: The rolling 12-month peak is 14% below sanctioned load, so fixed demand charges are over-paid.
decisions.whatHappens: Recommendation to file a contract-demand reduction with the utility.
decisions.counterfactual: Fixed demand charges continue on unused sanctioned capacity.

decisions.title: Curtail compressed-air leak load
decisions.why: Off-shift baseline flow is 18% above the commissioning benchmark, indicating a leak.
decisions.whatHappens: Isolate the zone 4 header off-shift pending a leak survey.
decisions.counterfactual: A continuous 34 kW loss persists, worth about ₹186,000 a year.

decisions.title: Re-plan after gateway heartbeat loss
decisions.why: Two heartbeats were missed on gateway GW-02 within 15 minutes.
decisions.whatHappens: Affected assets revert to Tier 1 and hold their last valid safe schedule.
decisions.counterfactual: Operating on stale state risks acting on data that no longer reflects the plant.
